car.name: Cicely 2010
car.description: Carlos Sainz / Lucas Cruz, 2010 Dakar-winning Volkswagen Race Touareg 2 inspiration. 2.5L twin-turbo five-cylinder diesel, permanent AWD and five-speed sequential. Original turquoise/orange raid prototype; torque-curve diesel approximation, not Race Touareg 3 or a road SUV.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: Carlos Sainz / Lucas Cruz, 2010 Dakar-winning Volkswagen Race Touareg 2 TDI prototype. Not Race Touareg 3, 2011 winner or road Touareg.

sources.access: Original December 2009 Dakar 2010 dossier names Sainz/Cruz and RT2. Technical table gives 2500 cc five-cylinder twin-turbo diesel, 280 CV, over 600 Nm, permanent AWD, five-speed sequential, 1787.5 kg minimum, dimensions, 235/85R16 tires and 250 mm suspension travel. Prose also says 300 CV; discrepancy retained, conservative table baseline selected.
Manufacturer January 2011 report retrospectively confirms Sainz/Cruz won in 2010; its current-event Race Touareg 3 and 310 CV are explicitly not applied here.
Driver official contemporary January 2010 entry names Carlos Sainz/Lucas Cruz and Volkswagen Race Touareg 2.

estimates: 276 mechanical hp approximates technical-table 280 CV; same dossier prose states 300 CV, so exact event output remains uncertain. 450 lb-ft (about 610 Nm) is an estimate consistent with published over 600 Nm, not a measured peak. Full torque curve, 900 idle, 4500 redline and 5000 limiter are approximate low-rev diesel delivery. 1787.5 kg is published minimum, not asserted loaded race mass.

Five-speed sequential and AWD architecture are sourced; exact ratios/final drive, nominal equal torque split, differential settings, shifting/launch, CG, overhang split, suspension damping/springs, brakes, aero, underbody protection and 28 psi are estimates. Sourced dimensions, 235/85R16 and 250 mm suspension travel retained. Game 0–60 target 6.2 seconds is estimated, not relabeled manufacturer 0–100 claim of 6.1 seconds.

Existing generic combustion powertrain uses custom torque curve and AWD; no dedicated diesel combustion, turbo staging, altitude mapping, sound or thermodynamic model is added. Generic fuel mechanics use estimated 250 L capacity, 12 US MPG reference and 0.3 US gal/hour idle, not verified Dakar range or consumption. Native FuelModel capacity limits remain unchanged.

Original turquoise/orange/sand body, dark allterrain wheels and roadbook cockpit are interpretations without logos or copied livery. Blank roadbook/navigation screens are decorative, not functional rally navigation. Live telemetry, shared steering wheel/wipers and sound are gameplay conventions. Auto Assist is accessibility, not factory automatic. Original PNGs retained; wheel opacity normalization affects decoded copy only.
